sources.snippet: Raon-1 mini is a 30B-A4B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model, designed and trained from scratch by KRAFTON AI. It demonstrates strong capabilities in Korean conversation and agentic tasks. As part of the Raon open model family, it is released under the Apache 2.0 license.
